text:
alice_support: Hi @eve_customer — saw your ticket, thanks for the repro. You're getting `401 invalid_api_key` after your org's SSO rotation? Can you paste the exact curl you ran (redact secret) and the response body?

eve_customer: repro steps below. We log in via SSO and then pass the access token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to your /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Started failing after our Okta rotation. Here's simplified curl (redacted):
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
Response: `{ "error": { "type": "invalid_api_key", "message": "API key not valid" } }`

alice_support: thanks. Couple of quick checks: are you hitting a proxy or ALB in front of your app? sometimes proxies drop or rewrite Authorization.

eve_customer: yes we have an internal auth proxy (org gateway). We didn't change it intentionally. This started right after SSO key rotation.

josh_dev: quick hypothesis — some gateways strip `Authorization` unless explicitly whitelisted. If your SSO rotation changed token format (e.g., different length or added dots), maybe the proxy treated it as sensitive and removed it. Can you capture the outgoing request from your app (curl from the same host or tcpdump) to confirm header is present?

maria_infra: we had an infra change same day — updated ALB header whitelist for security. I'll check rules.

sso-bot: Note: Okta rotation completed 2025-07-21T09:03:12Z. Old tokens invalidated.

eve_customer: captured request from host shows Authorization present when leaving app: `Authorization: Bearer ABC.DEF.GHI`

alice_support: ok then we need to see what arrives at api.redwood.ai. Can you run `curl -v` so we can see the raw request/response (redact token) and paste the request headers you see on our side from the ticket logs?

eve_customer: from our side to you (ingress): `> Authorization: Bearer ABC.DEF.GHI`
From your server logs (from the support ticket) shows no Authorization header. Only `X-Forwarded-For`, `Host`, `Content-Type`.

josh_dev: confirms proxy/ALB dropping header. Two options: 1) Add Authorization to the ALB/proxy allowed headers list; 2) Use the `api-key` header that bypasses some proxies, e.g., `X-Api-Key: <key>` (but note our API accepts only `Authorization: Bearer <key>` for SSO tokens; using `x-api-key` works for dashboard tokens in some flows).

maria_infra: I found the ALB config — we have a header sanitization rule that strips headers matching the regex for bearer tokens if they contain more than 2 dots. That was added to mitigate token leaks to logs. Rotation changed token format (now 2 dots -> 3 segments) so rule matched and stripped.

alice_support: thanks, that explains mismatch. Root cause: ALB rule sanitizes Authorization header when pattern matches new token format, causing 401 invalid_api_key at Redwood.

eve_customer: ouch. Any recommended fix short-term?

josh_dev: short-term: disable that specific sanitization rule or relax regex to only apply to *outbound* logging, not the forwarded request. Better: whitelist `Authorization` on the route to your backend so ALB doesn't remove it.

maria_infra: rolled back the header strip rule to a less aggressive variant at 2025-07-21T11:42Z. Re-tested: requests now include Authorization and calls succeed.

deploy-bot: deploy 2025-07-21T11:42:37Z maria_infra reverted header-sanitizer-rule (rev: 8a3f). :white_check_mark:

eve_customer: confirmed — calls success, thanks! Response now 200 and completions streaming. :tada:

alice_support: great. We'll add a KB note: proxies/ALBs can strip/alter Authorization when token formats change (SSO rotations). Recommend whitelisting Authorization header or avoid aggressive regex-based header sanitization.

josh_dev: also reminder: if customers are using Okta/OAuth access tokens as API keys, ensure token audience and scopes are correct. In this case it was literally header stripping so no scope issue.

alice_support: closing thread after KB created. Thanks @maria_infra and @josh_dev for fast triage.

eve_customer: thanks all!
